equations.name: bp_e2_cleanse_call_post
equations.expected:
forall m pc stackpointer ra p n s t.
    bp_e2_cleanse_call_post pc stackpointer ra p n m s t <=>
    read RIP t = ra /\
    val (read RSP t) = val stackpointer + 8 /\
    (forall i. i < n ==> read memory t (word_add p (word i)) = word 0) /\
    (forall a. ~assurance_region p n (val a) ==> read memory t a = m a) /\
    bytes_loaded t (word pc) openssl_cleanse_mc /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) t = ra /\
    (MAYCHANGE [RIP; RSP; RAX; RDI; RSI] ,,
     MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,,
     MAYCHANGE [memory :> bytes (p,n)] ,,
     MAYCHANGE [events])
    s
    t

equations.name: bp_e2_cleanse_pre
equations.expected:
forall m ra s xp rp wp ordinary pc p n stackpointer.
    bp_e2_cleanse_pre pc stackpointer ra p n m rp wp xp ordinary s <=>
    n < 2 EXP 64 /\
    pc + 97 <= 2 EXP 64 /\
    bytes_loaded s (word pc) openssl_cleanse_mc /\
    read RIP s = word pc /\
    read RSP s = stackpointer /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) s = ra /\
    C_ARGUMENTS [p; word n] s /\
    read memory s = m /\
    val stackpointer MOD 16 = 8 /\
    val stackpointer + 8 < 2 EXP 64 /\
    assurance_canonical48 (val ra) /\
    ~(ra = word pc) /\
    (read DF s <=> false) /\
    ~bit 18 (read rflags s) /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. xp a /\ ordinary a) pc 97 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) (val stackpointer) 8 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. wp a /\ ordinary a) (val p) n /\
    (forall a. ~(assurance_region p n a /\ assurance_region (word pc) 97 a)) /\
